name: Athaliah
bio: Athaliah, daughter of Omri, king of Israel (and so a daughter of Ahab's house), married Jehoram, king of Judah, and became the mother of Ahaziah, who succeeded his father as king of Judah (2 Kings 8:18, 26). Her marriage drew Judah's royal house into the ways and idolatry of Ahab's dynasty. Her far more dramatic and violent role in Judah's history is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
